# onetouchswitch (comparison platform)

> Local-first, self-hostable UK broadband comparison core for onetouchswitch.com: local postcode data (OS Code-Point Open), manual address, reviewed versioned offer catalogue, deterministic contract-cost engine, provider links with the copy "Published offer. Check availability with the provider." No orderability claims.

## Live static API
- [Catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/index.json)
- [Postcode file example HU1](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/postcode/HU1.json)
- [Providers](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/providers.json)
- [Published offers](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/catalogue/current.json)
- [Engine (ESM)](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/engine/v1/ots-engine.mjs)
- [Demo](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/)
